title: Watch and manicure gift set
description: a gift set containing a working watch, nail file, tweezers, cuticle scissors, and nail clipper, packaged in a zippered carry pouch
blurb: A retail set. The court must decide which item gives it its essential character.
reference_excerpt: The classification of the gift set must be broken down into its individual components as per the ruling. The gift set includes a working watch, which is classified under HTS code 9102.11.10 due to its quartz analog movement and gold-plated case and strap. The tweezers are classified under HTS code 8203.20.2000 as they fall under the category of pliers and similar tools. The nail file and nail clipper are classified under HTS code 8214.20.3000, which pertains to manicure or pedicure sets and instruments. Lastly, the cuticle scissors are classified under HTS code 8213.00.9000, which covers scissors and similar shears valued over a certain threshold.

gri_path: GRI 1: no single heading covers a watch plus manicure implements packaged together; goods are prima facie classifiable in headings 9102 (watches) and 8214 (manicure sets)

GRI 3(b): this is a set put up for retail sale (put up together to meet a specific need/activity, packaged for sale directly to users without repacking); classify by the component that gives essential character
Essential character: consistent with HQ H268657 (watch + charger set), the wristwatch is normally the dominant, highest-value, defining article of such combination gift sets, so heading 9102 controls

GRI 6: compare subheadings within 9102; assumed electrically operated wrist watch with mechanical (analog hands) display, no or one jewel in movement, strap/band of textile or base metal (not gold/silver plated) -> 9102.11.25.00, the residual 'Other' statistical line

classification.rationale: The set is a GRI 3(b) composite/retail set combining a watch (heading 9102) with manicure implements (heading 8214); by analogy to HQ H268657, the watch is the dominant, most valuable component and normally imparts essential character to such gift sets, placing the whole set in heading 9102. Within 9102.11, the exact statistical suffix depends on jewel count, case plating and strap material, none of which are stated, so 9102.11.25.00 (the residual 'other' line for non-plated, textile/base-metal strap, no/one jewel) is offered as the best-guess current 10-digit line pending confirmation.
